title: The Morning Not Yet Earned

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: Bone goes out as it came in, without a boundary drawn. A pot mended twice is trusted because the crack shows; a count kept in wood is trusted because no slate has taken a figure off it. The last tend ends with the hand going up an inch and coming down, and the reading still one morning ahead.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of the Clay Yard, told at the pot board and over the boards in the last tend of Bone

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of three hundred and six to three hundred and eight days, six months and one hundred and twenty-six to one hundred and twenty-eight days, carried everywhere in a basket and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing and is never a break in the narration: the body inventoried as a wound of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and an afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform; three counts in three places that do not become one, since agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stands; the carried fire kept in fours with its fifth unpaid and its payer unnamed; six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the heard bell in its square beside the told bell; the told figure beside the paid with three Frost arithmetics locked in Berr Clay's box up the clay road, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, three readings three and not one account with the finding on its own place and no payer; the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and unfigured; the twice-mended pot lifting on Sella's thumb where the wire crosses the crack with the crack left showing; the stayed frost gone off the well's north lip, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate called weather and entered nowhere; the seven walked-around places gone around with a look and a wide step and no number; nine hands with Ilva's ninth strip unread and no tenth, the Frost 14 saying at three shapings beside Hessa Rale's eighth, the burned slate at five tellings with a finger between the fifth and the four, the row at five askings with no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Tarn's loan uncalled, Jorra's promise ungiven and he's not Vail sealed, Garl held in objects with his name unspoken, the held changes kept on their own places and the house's not-doings kept apart from the boy's own gaps with a finger between; and the six small coordinations of the hand, the one hundred and eighty-seventh through the one hundred and ninety-second, entered on the sixth place and never promoted into a reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a gift, a doctrine or a rule. The old life stays offstage: no present-tense break, no tagged memory.
places: the flat stone by the well

scenes.title: The Seventh Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, the chapter's only \dropcap and its first \daymark{306}{Bone 7, Seventhday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof into the first light of an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell. Open on the hand laid down against the fold on the one hundred and eighty-sixth answer; do not recap Chapter 84, the reader has just read it. Carry 305 to 306 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-six days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and six days with its payer unnamed and Garl's name unspoken the same number (T088, T009/T013/T092). Nothing from Bone 4–6 comes in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment: not the fifth burned-slate telling, not the twice-mended pot, not Ilva's answering — five are five and a sixth is not due (T035/T031/T065/T095 held). Body inventory in the surgeon's old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past where a child would eat it, its empty place unnamed and no third; the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has given an instruction about the thread; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and will seem better before he is worse and must be warmed from outside and slowly; he wants the crust lifted two inches and cannot close two inches on the pot handle, both true and the second louder (T060/T086). Three counts in three places that do not become one: the fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand under the floor, the river's water over water at the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot (T061/T082, T088). Keepings checked and unchanged: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh empty; heard bell in its square beside the told; told figure beside the paid with three Frost arithmetics gone up the road, one in twelve printed, no signature on the space, three readings three and not one account, the finding on its own place and no payer; dressed grain unfigured; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; row at five askings with no witness; Frost 14 saying at three shapings beside Hessa's eighth hand; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread; burned slate at five, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T036/T076, T101, T080, T065/T095, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Sella to the fire before the basket: thaw to the coals, back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips along a two-gapped row with neither gap figured, one glance at the clay jar, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). She lifts the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crosses the crack before the weight comes on the handle, and says both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person; repair is not restoration and a mended vessel carries its break (T009/T013/T092). Tarn at the kindling keeps six in the thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, loan uncalled, no collector on the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra through the finger's-width shed with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, speech to the wheel and a pot before any person, full note known three turns ahead and withheld on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, men unnamed before first grey given no name, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, quieter when the burned-slate word goes around (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101 held). Garl in objects: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line with its finer grey called the thaw, proverb to pot and fire, uncalled tile debt worse for being uncalled. Hand up an inch toward the river's note; a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his laid beside the kiln's fourth low pull and not carried into the missing fifth. **Answer 187**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named. Hand down on the river's note; the gap stays a gap.

scenes.title: A Count Kept in Wood
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 306, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 7 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the worked strips as a direction, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate with the fold over his ears against the river wind and the instruction going to the wool and the wind and never to the basket. She goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number: the clean dark line at the Vail corner and the finer grey hairline beside it called the thaw, unswept both; the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates; the round ring where the shallow pan once stood with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word; the skinned water in the trough; the field's empty place out on the worked strips; the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086). The stayed frost has gone off the well's north lip while the yard looked elsewhere; the trough keeps its skin; the plate of ice lifted off it stands clouded with silt on the flat stone out of the path of feet. Three coverings in three places, all called weather and entered nowhere, kept with a finger between every pair, no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T083/T085 held). At the rack end the dressed grain lies under wool away from the hearth; she lifts a corner and turns it beneath the wool with a touch lighter than the morning's and gives it no figure, and the three Frost readings that went over it are not brought back as a lesson (T077). Bone's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures; a cost asked of the month is answered with the weather and a direction that leaves no entry (T077 advanced, not paid). **Ilva once at the well:** drawing with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb she does not scrub out; asked what the month's firings have taken, her hand goes toward her sleeve and stays there, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to any slate, charcoal, cord or private keeping, and no figure comes off the wood; her eyes go to the asker and her mouth opens after both: *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account.* The boy takes the order of reaching apart by what is there and what is not and files the ninth record-first hand on its own place beside Hessa Rale's eighth with a finger between, and files no tenth; nine are nine and must not stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands at the well (T080 advanced, not paid). She is not the woman whose voice came over the boards on Bone 5, not Marra, not Hessa, not the soft-cuffed clerk and not an officer, and is joined to none of them. Tarn keeps the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered stopping with no tenth and no collector, wants the late thaw because it puts off the paying, and his stroke goes over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076 held). Jorra keeps grey dust and silence with the bent finger leading at the damper, supplies no sixth to the burned-slate word and gives the men in the back room no name (T035/T031/T062 held). Sella's last grammar of the day: fire before basket, thaw, broken pot, *The house will keep it*, charcoal unread, two gaps unfigured, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). The hand sets a held interval beside an empty interval, brings the finger down between them and takes it up, leaving both as they were: **answer 188**, a keeping and not a spending, exact, worth nothing, no doctrine. Exact last image: Ilva's flat hand going back over her sleeve and the pail going down without a splash while the silt-clouded plate of ice stands on its flat stone out of the path of feet.

scenes.title: The Eighth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated \daymark{307}{Bone 8, Eighthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Eighthday, at the hearth, the pot board, the loaf shelf, the bed, the boards and the towel, with the kindling and the wheel-shed as sounds and directions. New day, new date, no recap; nothing from Bone 7 — not Ilva's answering, not the three coverings called weather, not the turned grain — is brought in as a lesson, sign, mending, cause or payment. Carry 306 to 307 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-seven days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and seven days, payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken three hundred and seven days (T009/T013/T092). The burned-slate word stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four and a sixth is not due on a day that has not earned it (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid). Bone's ordinary repair work holds, judged by the arm and the weather and never by a figure (T077). A pot on the board carries its twice-mended handle with the repair standing visible: two staples, one the colour of old brass, the second a wire drawn tighter and left longer than it needed, with a hairline of the crack showing dark between them; Garl's two sayings go to the pot and the fire and never to a person, and a repair that holds mends nothing anybody will name (T009/T013/T092, T058/T079). Body inventory renewed in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its unnamed empty place and no third; thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped; cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it; afterdrop beyond a warming nobody will perform. The ease cold puts on a face is not ease; a cold patient cannot clot; a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly, never hurried, never rubbed, never set too near the fire. He wants the crust lifted and the thread wiped and cannot close two inches on the pot handle; both voices argue and neither wins, and the argument is the work and not a virtue (T060/T086). Keepings unchanged and not brought forward: three counts in three places that do not become one; six hearings with the seventh empty; heard bell beside told; told figure beside paid with three Frost arithmetics locked up the road, three readings three and not one account, finding on its own place with no payer; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; row at five askings; Frost 14 saying at three shapings beside Hessa's eighth hand; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread; burned slate at five, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T036/T076, T101, T080, T065/T095, T064 held). Sella to the fire before the basket, thaw, back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it*, finger above the charcoal, lips along the two-gapped row, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). Tarn at the kindling: six checkable, seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged sentence, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, ear-sentence to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in knuckle creases, pale clip-ring, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, loan uncalled and no collector on the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and under the nails, not bone-coloured slip, keeps dusty and clean forearms on one tray parted as clot from vessel, asks neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, and puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies, joined to no kiln and entered in no slate (T035/T031/T062, T061/T082). The hand takes the half-beat between the pot's set-down and Sella going away and lays it beside a small intake from the next room on two places with a finger between, neither spent. **Answer 189**, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, gift, doctrine or rule, no payer named. Exact last image: the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with its handle turned toward it and the half-beat unfigured before Sella went away without a look toward the bed.

scenes.title: The Half-Check Returned
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry, no new dated heading: afternoon of Bone 8 through the going of the light and into the small hours at the Clay Yard, the yard well and its flat stone, the rack end, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the bed, boards and towel. **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, ADVANCED AND NOT PAID (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082):** at the going of the light, while Jorra's bent finger stood in the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and she allowed the end of it to arrive at the pot, Tarn's broom checked half a beat behind the standing finger on the flagstones and went on toward the road without a word or a turn of the head — the Seed 22 half-check and the Day 171 flagstone movement returned changed after a hundred and thirty-six days. The flagstones keep the place where the stroke stopped as a thing nobody enters; neither man names the other's silence; the loan that can hear is still uncalled and no collector comes up or goes down the clay road. The boy files the returned half-check on the flagstone's own place beside the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the returned beat at two breaths on Frost 5: four held changes on four places, and he forbids them to stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T062, T100, T036/T076, T061/T082). It is not repeated on Bone 7 or Bone 9, is not a hearing, a seventh, a tenth stopping, a payment, a reconciliation, a mercy or a gift, and Bone 10 can carry it unchanged. Sella carries him down at the half-pace from every open slate and goes wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). The stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate stay weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The dressed grain turns beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure; the three readings that went over it stay three and not one account and do not follow the grain under the wool (T077, T015/T041/T047). Jorra grows quieter when the burned-slate word goes around the boards, keeps it at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, supplies no sixth and no witness, and neither pays nor refuses the claim gathering against his ungiven promise; *he's not Vail* stays sealed (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid). Garl is kept in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and seven days: coat, hollow seat, clean dark line with its finer grey, proverb to pot and fire, uncalled tile debt worse for being uncalled (T009/T013/T092). Sella's last grammar: fire before basket, thaw, broken pot, *The house will keep it*, finger above the charcoal, two gaps unfigured, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening (T058/T079, T100). The hand holds the little interval between Jorra's finger arriving at the iron and the end of Sella's sentence reaching the pot as an interval on its own place and does not fill it to make a row come out even. **Answer 190**, exact, worth nothing, no payer named. Exact last image: the shallow bright patch on the flagstones where the broom checked, the stroke going on toward the road without a turn of the head, and the place where it stopped kept by nobody.

scenes.title: The Ninth Morning of Bone
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated \daymark{308}{Bone 9, Ninthday, Y.H. 813}: the small hours under the Vail roof into the first light of an ordinary Ninthday, at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the bed, the boards and the towel. New day, new date, no recap; the returned half-check of Bone 8 is not brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment and is not repeated — four held changes stay four and must not stand up as a rule (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held). Carry 307 to 308 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-eight days told by nobody (T071/T072); the carried fire's fifth unpaid three hundred and eight days with its payer unnamed (T088); Garl's name unspoken three hundred and eight days (T009/T013/T092). Bone goes on being the month of hunts and repairs judged by the arm and the weather, never by a figure; the carrying of a hare and the mending of a handle are directions and leave no entry (T077). Body inventory renewed in the old order: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, gone past the point where any child under any roof would eat it, its empty place beside it keeping its name to itself and no third coming in the night to make the row come out even; the thread of drool at the mouth frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, because nobody under this roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread and a basket set down is a pot set down and left; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare joint of the wrist where the wool has ridden back, as though it had come to the end of a line written out for it and had neither an order to go further nor an order to go away; afterdrop waiting beyond all three, past a warming nobody here will perform. He knows the composed face that is not composure and that a cold patient will seem better before he is worse; the infant wants the crust lifted to his mouth and the thread wiped away; both voices argue and neither wins and the argument is the work (T060/T086). Under the floor the fire keeps four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should stand; through the finger's-width door the river keeps water over water; overhead the boards keep four nails, four and a thumb-width knot — three counts in three places that do not become one, because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stands (T061/T082, T088). Keepings checked once more and unchanged: six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; heard bell in its square beside the told bell; told figure beside the paid with all three Frost arithmetics locked up the clay road, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, three readings three and not one account and the finding on a place of its own with no payer; the twice-mended pot with its crack showing; nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end; row at five askings with no witness; Frost 14 saying at three shapings beside Hessa's eighth hand; nine hands with Ilva's ninth unread; burned slate at five with a finger between; shut-room tellings at two; pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart; seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T036/T076, T101, T080, T065/T095, T064, T050/T051, T033/T034 held). Sella to the fire before the basket, thaw, back of a broken pot, *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stays unread, lips along a row with two gaps and neither figured, one glance at the clay jar, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; widow's mark untouched because a morning is not an opening and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079, T100). Tarn keeps six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey dust worked past the bent finger, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholds the full note he knows three turns ahead, moves the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence and keeps *he's not Vail* sealed, the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062). The hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the river's note, takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the same note — a restraint and not a payment, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air. **Answer 191**, exact, worth nothing, no payer named. Exact last image: the stiff leathery crust two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, and cold stopped at cheek, temple and the small bare joint of the wrist with the afterdrop waiting beyond.

scenes.title: The File Left Open
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 308, Bone 9, the going of the light and the small hours at the Clay Yard, yard well and flat stone, rack end, kindling, wheel-shed edge, bed, boards and towel. Bone goes on without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months is corrected; the yard goes around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, and the month's hunts and repairs stay directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, never figures (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T077). The stayed frost gone off the well's north lip, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice stay weather entered nowhere, three coverings in three places with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held). The returned half-check of Bone 8 stays on the flagstone's own place with the three older held changes beside it; four are four and not a rule, and no fifth likeness is made a cause (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held). Frost's three arithmetics with their true subtractions ride locked up the clay road in Berr Clay's box toward High Kiln, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, figure read still not figure paid, no signature on the space; three readings are three and not one account, and the finding sits on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine and not laid across the house's not-doings, the covered grain, the returned half-check or the boy's own kept gaps — edges nearly touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082). The burned-slate word stands at five with a finger between the fifth and the four; the sixth telling is not due on a day that has not earned it; no witness stands, no hand is named at the flame, and the seed waits on the far-off calling-in of Jorra's promise, not a confession and not a payment (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid). Tarn at the kindling keeps six where the house can check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl's unforged collector sentence, *Six counted. The next I don't count*, the ear-sentence brought to the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, loan uncalled and no collector up or down the road (T036/T076, T006). Jorra comes through the finger's-width shed with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parted dusty and clean forearms, speaks to the wheel and a pot before any person, knows the full note three turns ahead and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, puts his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, gives the men unnamed before first grey no name and does not say the room was cold; burned slate five, shut-room tellings two, pot sayings three with the Smoke 14 note apart, row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101 held). Garl stays in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and eight days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey, proverb said to pot and fire, uncalled tile debt worse for being uncalled (T009/T013/T092). Small keepings stay small and are not brought forward: the charcoal under the shelf unread, Ilva's strip in her sleeve offstage on Bone 8 and 9 and her ninth hand nine with no tenth and no figure off the wood, the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying beside Hessa's eighth hand, the row at five askings, the seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the reed-cutter's cord where no Court thumb has read it, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called — none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment (T100, T080, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T099, T090 held). Sella's last grammar: fire before basket, thaw, broken pot, *The house will keep it*, finger above the charcoal, two gaps unfigured, clay jar glanced at once, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow's mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079, T100). He turns out the file as he once turned instruments out on a towel and finds every gap left gap. At the very end of the day the hand takes a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and lets it go whole on the river's low note, not carried into the fire's missing fifth, the bell's gap left behind in the square or the river's low over lower. **Answer 192**, exact, complete, worth nothing, promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule, no payer named. Ledger close: **308** exact, six months and 128 days told by nobody; fire's fifth unpaid 308 days, payer unnamed; Garl's name unspoken 308 days; **192** honest answers on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and neither number nor hand-movings standing up as a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The hand laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking. Bone 10 (Day 309), the month's first Account-day and market, stands one morning ahead and is not brought into a day that has not earned it. Exact last image: the file lying open on the towel at the head of the bed with every gap left gap, every tray parted by a finger's width and nothing moved; the river's low note going quiet under the finger's-width door, the plate of ice standing clouded with silt on its flat stone out of the path of feet, and Bone going on without a boundary drawn.
